author: David Bombal
description:
Want to learn how to hack for free?

Yan Shoshitaishvili explains how pwn.college takes learners from basic Linux skills all the way to advanced cybersecurity challenges.

AI can also help you get unstuck along the way, but the key is using it as a mentor rather than letting it do the work for you.

Build the skills first. Then use AI as a force multiplier.

Thank you to ThreatLocker for sponsoring this video and my trip to Black Hat USA. 

Learn more about pwn.college: https://pwn.college/
#Cybersecurity #Hacking #AI
title: Learn How to Hack for Free
